statement: Pinned xone maps wireless association requests and disassociation or client-lost events into receiver-owned ordered workqueue operations, guarded by receiver readiness and wireless-client entry bounds. An association for an already active client is ignored. The USB receiver lifetime and the per-client GIP adapter lifecycle are distinct.

applicability.revision: Out-of-tree xone f2aa9fe01103d7600553b505b298ff0bd47ff280; Linux v7.3 or pinned SDL where cited
applicability.scope: transport/dongle.c:517-559, 632-689, 722-756, 820-944. Receiver event behavior from source; no physical radio frames or host timing measured.
